name: Han Joo Chae
title: Chief Business and Technology Officer
tagline: Medical AI executive taking regulated AI products to global markets.
pov: Medical AI matters only when it clears regulatory review, earns clinicians' trust, and reaches patients worldwide. As a technologist turned business leader, I build the partnerships, channels, and teams that take it there.
summary: Medical AI executive leading global business at Oncosoft, where I head the Global Business Division and drive expansion of AI radiation-oncology software across the US, Japan, Southeast Asia, and Latin America. I come from the technical side: I have built AI organizations from zero and taken products from prototype to regulated launch (FDA, CE, MFDS). At ROKIT Healthcare, I drove the commercial cycle from MVP to $1B+ in long-term contracts across the US, India, Turkey, the Middle East, and Latin America.
